description: Godun wears a long dark navy wool kaftan with brown-grey fur edging at the collar and cuffs, blue-and-gold geometric embroidered bands along the front, cuffs and hem, and small round metal clasps near the upper chest. A broad decorated brown belt with a circular centre buckle and rectangular side fittings secures the coat. A cream embroidered linen shirt shows at the neckline and below the opening, over loose brown trousers tucked into tall dark brown leather boots. His head and hands are uncovered; no armor or weapons are visible.
